verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026. The Institute was set up by a government decision announced on 25 November 2025; the stored files hold no text of an establishing instrument, so title, date and status rest on announcements and government documents about the Institute, which count as alt-official. Stored for this record: the Department of Industry, Science and Resources news item of 25 November 2025 (the official URL; stored 11 Oct 2026 and found unchanged since), which gives the announcement, the Institute's tasks, its complementary role, operation from early 2026, membership of the international network and the 17 December update on the network's new name; and the Government response to the Senate Select Committee on Adopting Artificial Intelligence (industry.gov.au, tabled 1 April 2026; secondary source), which gives the funding, the testing of frontier AI models and that the Institute will not be a regulator. The minister's joint media release of 25 November 2025 and the Institute's own page on industry.gov.au, which shows it as part of the department with 3 goals, joint testing and publications up to October 2026, were stored by the recheck of 17 Oct 2026.

title.locator: Australia to establish new institute to strengthen AI safety, lead paragraph
title.quote: The Australian Government is establishing an Australian Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute to respond to AI-related risks and harms.

date_published.locator: Australia to establish new institute to strengthen AI safety, More information
date_published.quote: The minister announced the Australian AI Safety Institute on 25 November 2025

status.locator: Australia to establish new institute to strengthen AI safety, lead paragraph
status.quote: The AI Safety Institute will become operational in early 2026.
the Australian Government provided $29.8 million over 4 years from 2025–26 (and $7.9 million per year ongoing from 2029–2030) to establish the Australian AI Safety Institute.

issuing_body.quote: Australia to establish new institute to strengthen AI safety | Department of Industry Science and Resources

legal_force.quote: The AI Safety Institute will not be a regulator.

legal_force.locator: Australia to establish new institute to strengthen AI safety, body
legal_force.quote: Its work will complement existing legal and regulatory frameworks that already protect Australians’ rights and safety.

The Institute's own page stored by the recheck of 17 Oct 2026 shows it working, with publications up to October 2026. Published (non-binding, current) stands.

Rule 7c does not apply: no statute, decree or other text establishing the Institute is published among the stored sources, so the official URL stays and the record stays at level B.
